# PDFCraft Studio
> The Zero-Cloud, 100% Client-Side PDF Utility Suite. Free forever, zero server uploads, zero paywalls.

PDFCraft Studio (https://pdf-craft-vert.vercel.app/) is a private, client-side web application for PDF document editing, compression, signing, conversion, and ATS resume creation. All operations execute strictly in browser memory using WebAssembly, HTML5 Canvas, and Web Workers. Sensitive documents never leave the user's device.

## Core Capabilities & Tools
- Target Size Squeezer: Compress PDFs down to exact file ceilings (<50KB, <100KB, <200KB, <300KB, <500KB) for government and university portal uploads.
- Digital Signature & E-Sign: Draw vector signatures, type names, add date stamps, and sign documents offline without creating an account.
- Universal Converters: Convert PDF to Word (.docx), PDF to Excel (.xlsx), JPG/PNG to PDF, and PDF to JPG without cloud processing.
- ATS Resume Studio: 60-second vector-crisp, ATS-compliant resume builder with keyword scoring and live job description matching.
- AI Contract Risk Radar: Client-side heuristic clause analysis detecting liability traps, automatic renewals, and non-compete clauses.
- Document Organizer: Visual drag-and-drop page reordering, rotation, deletion, splitting, and merging.
- Redaction & Sanitizer: Permanent vector pixel rasterization to black out SSNs, bank details, and personal data.
